answer: Require every reward to pass a rotating quorum of independent peer graders who stake their own standing on each verdict. The vault of epoch rewards opens only when a quorum agrees an answer is a real mechanism, so a sybil army grading its own clones fails the moment outsiders join the panel. A prism splits one submission into many independent views, and a walnut shell of a fake identity cracks under contradictory grades — collusion needs a majority of the whole network, not just a loud minority.
